notes: A. James Clark School of Engineering official Fall 2026 Aerospace Engineering graduation plan. Gen Ed, ENGL/FSOC/FSPW and free-elective slots are left out: only the major is audited.

The plan's generic 'Technical Elective' slot (catalog footnote 5, 'approved for this purpose by the Undergraduate Program Director') is left out entirely -- no enumerable course list exists in any source, so it is not encoded as a requirement (see reviewNotes / docs/project/owner-review.md) and no real course id can be attributed to it here.
Track choice filled with the Aeronautical Track: ENAE403 or 404 -> ENAE403; ENAE455 or 457 -> ENAE455; ENAE491 or 493 -> ENAE491; ENAE492 or 494 -> ENAE492.

The plan's two generic 'ENAE Elective' slots (Year 4) are filled with ENAE425 (Mechanics of Composite Structures) and ENAE471 (Aircraft Flight Testing), both from the catalog's 'Aerospace Electives' list; neither is required by the Aeronautical track, so both are eligible.
